results.detail: Each unit was re-derived from the raw DTSX. Unit 1: donotsendmm and gen_quarterstatement are unqualified in the WHERE (DTSX:858-859), and the text labels the Contact ownership as a hypothesis (השערה). Unit 2: the cross-package SQL comments are quoted exactly. 0005_Customer Account.dtsx:32056 reads 'temp.gen_joiningstatus = 7 -- status send to the bank', and temp.gen_joiningstatus is aj.gen_joiningstatus from gen_automatedjoining aj (0005:32051-32055). 0037_MeetTheCustomerGemel.dtsx:4762 reads 'gen_automatedjoining.gen_joiningstatus = 8 --> Finish', and 0037:3232 is the same comment in a query FROM gen_automatedjoining. 0035:857 'where gen_joiningstatus in(7,8)' is unqualified. Unit 3: Update Contact main.cs (DTSX:1184-1221) always writes gen_notauthorizeforuse (the value or null). It writes donotsendmm=false only when gennewcompanyemailagreement == 1 (DTSX:1204-1207) and gen_quarterstatement=true only when gennewmarketinginquiriesagreement == 1 (DTSX:1209-1212). These inputs are bound to the source columns gen_automatedjoining.gen_newcompanyemailagreement / gen_newmarketinginquiriesagreement (component inputs [3]/[4]), not to the UpdateEmailAgreement / UpdateMarketingAgreement CASE columns. A catch routes failures to the Errors output, which has no path (paths DTSX:1963-1964 only). Nothing in the package writes gen_emailagreementupdate or gen_marketingagreementupdate. Under the Contact hypothesis, branch A needs donotsendmm != 0 and branch B needs gen_quarterstatement != 1 (DTSX:858-859). After a successful update a request is therefore re-selected only in cases (a) or (b), so the 'only if' list is exhaustive. Unit 4: no supplied DTSX has labels or option values for donotsendmm or gen_quarterstatement (grep over source/DailyProcess/*.dtsx: the only hits are 0035:858-859, 1206, 1211, and an unrelated DoNotSendMM script column in 0008). Not a defect, only a precision note: 'מוקדמים מ-CreatedOn' stands for DATEDIFF(second, update, CreatedOn) > 0. That counts second boundaries, so an update earlier than CreatedOn within the same second does not qualify. Writing 'מוקדמים בשנייה שלמה לפחות (DATEDIFF בשניות > 0)' would make the text exact. Also outside this claim's scope: AND binds tighter than OR in the WHERE (DTSX:857-859), so 'gen_joiningstatus in(7,8)' applies only to branch A.
